Given the miraculous and nearly identical stories of Norla (supplying Cadsuaine with valuable experience and resources for what she must become) and Nakomi (pushing Aviendha in just the right direction during her second trip to Rhuidean), I believe the two of them are functionally identical. More specifically, I believe they are either

*Avatars of the Creator
*Manifestations of the pattern, similar to the way TAR promotes the light
*Deus Ex Machina for the respective author (but then, if you think about it, where is the difference ;-)
